title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
description: Juicy chicken marinated in lemon and herbs.
steps: Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, pepper, and herbs.
Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes.
Grill chicken 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.

title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
description: Rich and creamy pasta with sautéed mushrooms.
steps: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Sauté mushrooms in butter until golden.
Add cream and simmer until slightly thickened.
Stir in parmesan, season, and toss with pasta.

title: Spicy Tofu Stir-Fry
description: Crispy tofu with colorful veggies in a spicy sauce.
steps: Press tofu and cut into cubes.
Stir-fry tofu until crispy; set aside.
Combine tofu with sauce and cook 1-2 minutes.
